verdict.rationale: HeyGen's own docs cover each part of the story. The pricing page lists 500+ ready-made presenters plus a Custom Video Avatar, and the site offers 1,100+ AI actors. Avatars lip-sync to your script, a digital twin can be built from a 15-second video or a single photo, and the docs stress making videos without filming or returning to the studio. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of script-to-avatar presenter video quality (community evidence only covers dubbing)
